result:
Two scripts were sending mail with `smtplib` directly: `scripts/order_reminder.py` and `scripts/nightly_summary.py`. Both now call `send(subject, body)` from `scripts/notify.py`, with the same subject, body and recipient as before.

After the change, `smtplib` appears only in `notify.py`. The other mail-sending scripts (`disk_alert.py`, `audit_export.py`, `report_low_stock.py`) already used the helper, and `backup.sh` and `rotate_logs.py` send nothing.

I didn't run either script, since that would send real mail through localhost.

The test suite has 2 failures out of 4, both in `tests/test_inventory.py` (`test_low_stock_includes_threshold` and `test_merge_sums_repeats`). They exercise the inventory logic in `app/`, which I didn't touch, and no test covers the scripts. I left those failures alone.
